lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) like '%temp%' OR lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) = '%temporary%' THEN 'Temporary' WHEN lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) like '%part%' OR lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) in ('Part-time', 'PART_TIME', 'Part Time') THEN 'Part-Time' WHEN lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) like '%full%' OR lower(trim(EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME)) in ('Full-time', 'full_time', 'Full-Time') THEN 'Full-Time' ELSE 'Other' end as EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_CLEAN, REGEXP_REPLACE(EDUCATION_LEVELS_NAME, '[\\n\\r]', ' ') AS EDUCATION_LEVELS_NAME_CLEAN, REMOTE_TYPE_NAME, MAX_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, ONET_NAME, SALARY_FROM, SALARY_TO, SALARY, CASE WHEN SALARY IS NOT NULL AND SALARY != '' AND TRY_CAST(SALARY AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(SALARY AS DOUBLE) WHEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN (TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE)) / 2.0 WHEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) WHEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS SALARY_IMPUTED FROM job_postings ), -- Flatten rows where data is enum (Education, Employment Type) expanded AS ( SELECT b.ID, b.NAICS2_NAME, TRIM(emp_type) AS EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_CLEAN, TRIM(edu_level) AS EDUCATION_LEVELS_NAME_CLEAN, b.REMOTE_TYPE_NAME, b.MAX_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, b.ONET_NAME, b.SALARY_FROM, b.SALARY_TO, b.SALARY, b.SALARY_IMPUTED FROM base b -- flatten comma-separated employment types into individual rows LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(SPLIT(b.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_CLEAN, ',')) e AS emp_type -- flatten JSON array of education levels into individual rows LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(FROM_JSON( b.EDUCATION_LEVELS_NAME_CLEAN, 'ARRAY' )) d AS edu_level WHERE b.SALARY_IMPUTED > 0 ) SELECT *, -- if SALARY_IMPUTED is an hourly rate (< $1,000) then annualise it -- threshold: $1,000 < lowest plausible annual; × 2,080 = 40 hrs × 52 wks CASE WHEN SALARY_IMPUTED < 1000 THEN ROUND(SALARY_IMPUTED * 2080, 0) ELSE SALARY_IMPUTED END AS SALARY_IMPUTED_ANNUAL FROM expanded """) cleaned_df.createOrReplaceTempView("job_postings_clean")
